item: Row 334: the uninstall watcher's audit log names no path and no process id
summary: The watcher logged the server pid and full launcher/venv/data/store/app paths (the home folder and user name in each) plus OSError text; each path is now its role (<data>, <home>/.../<file name>, .../<file name>), an unreadable one <path withheld>, never as given; a failed removal gives strerror.
